children: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp reported net income of $581631 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, and net income of $660739 for the six months ended July 31, 2026. The special-purpose acquisition company has no operating revenue yet and is focused on completing a previously announced business combination.
Net income was $581,631 for the three months ended July 31, 2026; year-to-date net income was $660,739 for the six months ended July 31, 2026.
Diluted EPS was $0.03 for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (ordinary shares subject to possible redemption).
Completed an IPO and full over-allotment, raising $115M, which was placed largely in a trust to fund a future business combination.
Entered a definitive merger agreement to acquire Robseek Intelligence in a multi-step merger tied to a $1B pre-money valuation.
No revenue-generating operations yet; current activity centers on deal sourcing, due diligence and public-company compliance.
Engaged Wealthwise as a finder and Polaris Advisory as underwriter, with right-of-first-refusal and advisory arrangements for future transactions.
Expect increased public company operating costs and trust interest income; company notes substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern until the combination closes.
